> What's you `'guicursor'` option?

Hi~
This is my guicursor option: `guicursor=n-v-c-sm:block-Cursor,i-ci-ve:ver25-Cursor,r-cr-o:hor20-Cursor`
 
In addition，the background color of cursor is changed in noice command wind, but not in text buffer.
![test](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8435488/195481848-09a3f8fa-1ea8-42a8-9231-6c052acfdb52.png)

Bisected to 34d41baf8a8e4ab8c006b7f29a8106e60e311aa2.

`Cs` for `xterm-256color` is `\E]12;%p1%s\007`. Therefore, it should be necessary to set a string like `rgb:\x\{1,4}/\x\{1,4}/\x\{1,4}`, `#\x\{6}` (vim regular expression) or color name with `unibi_var_from_str()`.

Ref. https://www.x.org/releases/X11R7.5/doc/man/man3/XParseColor.3.html#sect4

The current implementation should send `\E]12;\007` to the terminal. So, I do not believe that https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/34d41baf8a8e4ab8c006b7f29a8106e60e311aa2 will solve the foot problem.

Cc: @kraftwerk28.
This command work as expected when change from 'xterm-256color' to 'rxvt-256color'.

@buddhiko1 yes but you shouldn't be required to change the default TERM value for you terminal.

Currently cursor in xfce4-terminal-emulator (and probably others) is broken. Strangely it works fine in Iterm2 (also using `xterm-256color`). Anyway it worked fine in 0.7, not sure why it was changed.

@erw7 is right. The relevant code for handling of `%p1%s` is here https://github.com/mauke/unibilium/blob/e3b16d6219ca1cb92d98b1d9cc416b49a3ac468e/unibilium.c#L1228-L1242.

Neovim sets numeric params and so `%p1` pushes a numeric param. The `%s` pops a string param. Both unibilium and ncurses default to an empty string in the case a numeric param was popped. xterm and Alacritty define `Cs` using `%p1%s`. Neovim currently defaults to `%p1%06x` if `Cs` is missing in terminfo for these terminals, which correctly formats the numeric param it sets: these terminals expect "legacy" hex color input like `#0099ff` or input like `rgb:00/99/ff`.

That's why setting `TERM=rxvt-256color` works: rxvt's terminfo doesn't specify `Cs`.

Perhaps the better behavior would be for Neovim to set a hex color string param, but I'm not sure if there's some broader convention for parameters to `Cs` (or any "user-defined" terminfo capability for that matter).

issue.title: fix(tui): set cursor color parameter as string when required

issue.body:
See #20628. Terminals supporting cursor color changing usually set the "user-defined" `Cs` terminfo capability. Most terminals expect the parameter to the capability to be a string (in hex format like `#0099ff` or like `rgb:00/99/ff`), others may expect a number.

Neovim currently can't handle string parameters, causing terminals to receive a bogus command.

Unfortunately, as the `Cs` capability is "user-defined", there's no strict format. The parameter it takes isn't really standardized. It seems most terminals in use follow xterm; iTerm appears to be an exception.

This PR makes using the `Cs` capability more reliable by following terminfo and sending the color in hex format, at the cost of using unibilium string vars. Alternatively, https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/34d41baf8a8e4ab8c006b7f29a8106e60e311aa2 could be reverted and the specific format required by terminals to be hardcoded, instead of reading from terminfo.

Fixes #20628, #19607.
